summary: Churchill Downs Incorporated filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, announcing a completed comprehensive portfolio review and exploration of strategic alternatives to sell all of its wholly owned regional gaming properties, including Calder Casino, Terre Haute, Hard Rock Iowa, Oxford, Ocean Downs, Harlow's, Riverwalk, del Lago, and Presque Isle Downs. No pricing, terms, or timetable were provided, and the company offered no assurances of any transaction. The board did not announce a formal recommendation or advisors in the filing. The sales are subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for potential divestiture announcements, possible price discovery, and regulatory processes as the review progresses.
